workflow_rationale: The spec asks to add a new client-facing capability (one-click PDF export) to the existing Reports page. It is a single-service Next.js frontend change with new reusable UI pieces and print/PDF handling, so it follows the feature workflow.

phases.name: Report Data Models & Utilities
phases.description: Extract reusable report data helpers and TypeScript types so the report can aggregate BOM, MDB feeder list, cable schedule, breaker schedule, and project branding consistently.

subtasks.description: Create report aggregation helpers (BOM, feeder rows, cable rows, breaker rows) in src/lib/reports/aggregates.ts
Create report TypeScript types in src/lib/reports/types.ts

phases.name: Backend Branding & Logo
phases.description: Allow a project-level logo override to flow from the database to the reports page so each PDF can carry custom branding.

subtasks.description: Add project-level logoUrl field to project detail GET and PUT API responses / updates
subtasks.notes: Verified project detail GET returns logoUrl and PUT updates logoUrl. Source route.ts already contained required logic. Type check passed. API verification passed.

subtasks.description: Add logo upload input to project settings UI on the project detail page
subtasks.notes: Added logoUrl to Project type, projectLogoUploading state, handleProjectLogoUpload and handleClearProjectLogo helpers, and a Project Logo upload block inside the project settings panel. Type check passed. Dev server renders the page and project API returns logoUrl. Full production build blocked by unrelated /settings localStorage SSR issue.

phases.name: Printable Report Components
phases.description: Build reusable, print-friendly React components for the cover page, schedule sections, and section headers. Keep them dependency-free from browser-only APIs so they can be rendered inside the existing page.

subtasks.description: Create printable cover page component at src/components/report/CoverPage.tsx
subtasks.notes: Created src/components/report/CoverPage.tsx with print-friendly layout, project metadata, logo support, and ProCal brand styling. Type check passed. Committed.

subtasks.description: Create printable schedule components (BOM, MDB, Cable, Breaker, Voltage Drop) under src/components/report/
subtasks.notes: Implemented five print-friendly schedule components mirroring the existing reports and schedule pages. Used shared helpers (isThreePhaseForItem, computeFeeders) and project types. Type check passed. Committed.

subtasks.description: Create printable ReportHeader and SectionHeader components with project metadata and logo
subtasks.notes: Created src/components/report/ReportHeader.tsx with printable ReportHeader (company/logo/project metadata) and SectionHeader (section title/subtitle/trailing controls). Type check passed. Committed.

phases.name: Reports Page Integration
phases.description: Replace the ad-hoc print section in Reports page with the new reusable printable components, add a one-click PDF export button using window.print/Paged.js, and ensure proper pagination.

subtasks.description: Add PDF export button and integrate printable components into src/app/(app)/reports/page.tsx

checks: Print preview shows cover page + schedules

subtasks.notes: Added PDF export button, integrated CoverPage, ReportHeader, BOMSchedule, MDBSchedule, CableSchedule, BreakerSchedule and VDSchedule components into src/app/(app)/reports/page.tsx. Screen tab renders summary plus each schedule via tabs; print-only section renders full cover page + schedules with page breaks. Settings API supplies company logo. Type check passed. Project-level lint passed for modified file. Full production build blocked by existing /settings localStorage SSR issue unrelated to this subtask. Browser verification shows the reports page chunk loads; initial Loading state is expected because selectedProjectId is empty on first SSR and fetch happens client-side via ProjectContext/localStorage.

subtasks.description: Enhance print styles in src/app/globals.css for correct pagination, page breaks, header/footer and report section layout

verification.instructions: Open /reports, click Export PDF/Print, verify cover page is on first sheet and each schedule starts on a new page with table headers repeating.

subtasks.notes: Enhanced @page rules with A4 size, running page footer, and :first page margin reset for cover page. Added print helpers (.page-break-before, .page-break-after, .avoid-break). Expanded @media print to reset heights/overflow, hide sidebar/nav/buttons, show #print-all-tabs, preserve report-header, size cover-page to full A4, force each schedule section to a new page, repeat table headers, avoid row splits, and style tables for print. Verified production CSS contains the new rules; full production build is blocked by unrelated /settings localStorage SSR issue.

subtasks.description: Update app layout print behavior so the sidebar hides and main area fills the page when printing from /reports

verification.instructions: Open browser print preview on /reports and confirm sidebar is hidden and content uses full page width.

subtasks.notes: Moved sidebar margin offset from inline style to a conditional md:ml-[240px] Tailwind class so it drops on narrow breakpoints and print. Added flex-shrink-0 to the sidebar wrapper. Sidebar already hides via print:hidden wrapper; main fills the full printed width using globals.css print overrides. Type check and lint passed.

phases.name: Tests & QA
phases.description: Add unit tests for report aggregation helpers, component-level Vitest smoke tests, and run the project's lint/test suite.

subtasks.description: Add Vitest unit tests for src/lib/reports/aggregates.ts using a fixture project
subtasks.notes: Added src/lib/reports/aggregates.test.ts with fixture project covering aggregateBOM, aggregateFeederRows, aggregateCableRows, aggregateBreakerRows, and aggregateVoltageDropRows. All 25 tests pass with npm test -- src/lib/reports/aggregates.test.ts.

subtasks.description: Run full test suite and lint and fix any failures

verification.expected: All tests pass and no lint errors

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Sequential only: each phase builds on previous components

acceptance_criteria: Reports page shows a one-click Export PDF/Print button
Print preview includes a cover page with project metadata and logo
BOM, MDB, Cable, Breaker and Voltage Drop schedules are included
Each schedule section paginates correctly in print/PDF output
Existing tests pass and new unit tests cover aggregation helpers

verification_steps.name: Browser Print Preview
verification_steps.expected_outcome: Reports page exports cover page + schedules with correct pagination

verification_strategy.reasoning: Medium risk because the feature changes the main Reports page, introduces reusable components, and touches print CSS; unit tests plus a manual browser print check are sufficient for a single-service frontend feature.
